methods.label: Divide the denominator by 4
methods.explanation: The greatest common factor is 4, \(12\div4=3\), and \(\frac{8}{12}=\frac{2}{3}\).
methods.levelReason: The requested calculation uses elementary table division. Finding the greatest common factor and reducing the surrounding fraction are within Grade 5.

needsNewNodes.name: Evaluating exact whole-number quotients
needsNewNodes.description: Evaluate the whole-number quotient of a nonnegative whole-number dividend by a positive whole-number divisor when the dividend is a multiple of the divisor, without prescribing a calculation method.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p046 prescribes multiplication facts, while cnm_p083 describes a written place-value division procedure. Neither precisely represents the route-neutral target of evaluating the requested quotient.
